headline: Uno Minda plans massive capex to scale EV components and seating
hook: Pushing for ₹40,000 crore revenue by FY30
summary: Uno Minda is directing ₹1,750 crore toward FY27 capital expenditure to expand into electric drives, seating, sunroofs, and advanced electronics. Chairman Nirmal Minda projects India's passenger vehicle market to exceed five million units driven by premiumisation and tighter safety and emission regulations. This product line expansion increases component content per vehicle for the listed auto ancillary maker. Retail investors holding auto component stocks can track this capex intensity as a proxy for EV and premiumisation trends in Indian automotive manufacturing.
whats_next: FY27 capital expenditure execution and order wins
why_it_matters: Long-term revenue growth tied to EV and premiumisation trends.
winners_losers: Uno Minda gains / traditional component makers hurt
